_meta.purpose: Taxonomy of payment decline reasons for the Smart Recovery Engine. Grounded in published industry benchmarks (Slicker, ChurnWard, Chargebee, Razorpay blog) for occurrence weights and recovery rates, since real per-transaction retry logs are not publicly available.

decline_codes.description: Card or account had insufficient balance at time of charge
decline_codes.notes: Highly time-sensitive - success probability rises sharply near salary-credit dates

decline_codes.description: Bank/issuer server did not respond in time (network/infra issue, not a real decline)
decline_codes.notes: Not the customer's fault at all - safest and highest-value retry candidate

decline_codes.description: Generic temporary decline from issuer, often a soft risk flag
decline_codes.notes: Ambiguous code - treat as soft but do not over-retry
Retrying is pointless - needs a new card on file

decline_codes.description: Card reported lost or stolen, blocked by issuer
decline_codes.notes: Never retry - only escalate to new payment method

decline_codes.description: CVV or card number mismatch, likely stale stored token
decline_codes.notes: Needs re-entry of card details by customer

decline_codes.description: UPI AutoPay mandate exists but was not confirmed in the payer's app in time
decline_codes.notes: Common India-specific failure - customer often just didn't open the app in time

decline_codes.description: Failure at the payer's UPI app (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm) or PSP server, not the bank
Customer actively cancelled the UPI AutoPay mandate
decline_codes.notes: This is voluntary churn, not involuntary - exclude from recovery funnel, route to win-back instead

decline_codes.description: Issuing bank's server was down/under maintenance at charge time
decline_codes.notes: Pure infra issue - retry after a few hours almost always works
